assumptions: BATCH 100 IS `asset`, AND §6's REGISTRY RESERVES 100 TO IT: owner A4 Asset, output "Asset detailed schema", depends on 020, 050, 061 and 080. All four are merged. Migration invariant 1 forbids rewriting any of them and nothing in this increment does: every statement creates a new object or attaches a policy to one this file created, and no `drop policy` names a policy another batch wrote.

§5's INVENTORY NAMES SIX OBJECTS AND THIS BATCH CREATES FOUR, each argued rather than inherited from a list. app.assets (the "logical" half of §5's "logical mutable; versions immutable"), app.asset_versions (the "versions" half), app.asset_rights (§8.2's "Asset rights/share" row and §9.1's RIGHTS-3 class) and app.content_asset_links (§4's ERD gives it both parents by name). `backup` and `usage` are REFUSED with a reason each and are in the open blockers, and the asset design's other seven tables are refused because §5's inventory does not name them and §2's conflict order puts §5 above a plan document.

THE `S` CELL IS CLASSIFIED AND NOT ENFORCED, AND THAT IS THE DECISION IN EFFECT RATHER THAN A DEFERRAL. §8.2's "Asset hard purge | N | N | N | N | N | S" is named in RFC-2026-022 §3's own table for batches 100 and 160 and called BOTH: CARRIED when §11.4's workspace closure drives it, DISCOVERED when a retention sweep does. Both statements are recorded in db/foundation/lint/service-policy-map.json keyed on (cell, statement) as §7.2 requires. NO SERVICE POLICY IS WRITTEN: RFC-2026-022 is approved and NOT IN EFFECT (§5/8, and M9 measures that the only member of app_worker is postgres, which bypasses RLS), so a policy TO app_worker would admit nobody while making every service-sees-zero-asset-* case pass for a reason unrelated to it.

BOTH PURGE STATEMENTS ARE `update` AND NEITHER IS `delete`. §9.3/11 of the object storage lifecycle contract makes the hard purge "อัปเดต `deleted_at/purged_at` แบบ idempotent" and §11.5 confirms it from the support side ("visible to support as redacted status"), so the row survives as a redaction. NO ROLE HOLDS DELETE ON ANY TABLE THIS BATCH CREATES.

TWO MUTABILITIES COME FROM §5 AND TWO ARE DECIDED FROM A SENTENCE THIS INCREMENT QUOTES. app.asset_rights is MUTABLE on §8.2's "Asset rights/share | Y | Y | N | P | N | P" -- owner and admin hold the verb, THE EDITOR IS `N` here and `Y` two rows above for upload, and the approver's `P` is refused (RFC-2026-020 §8). app.content_asset_links is APPEND-ONLY on batch 100's OWN READING of §4.7's rule "การแก้ link หลังอนุมัติต้อง invalidate Approval": that sentence conditions mutation on a mechanism batch 090 has not written, and §8.2's "Approved/published version UPDATE/DELETE" is `N` for every role including the service. The reading is refusable and the migration says where a reviewer would refuse it.

THE VERSION IS IMMUTABLE IN ALL BUT FOUR COLUMNS AND THE FOUR ARE AN ALLOWLIST, NOT A CONVENIENCE. `status` (§7.1 of the asset design assigns media readiness to it by name; §4 invariant 5 requires a pinned version to be `ready`), `object_key` and `purged_at` (§10's purge) and `updated_at` (§3.2). Everything else -- including `sha256` and `byte_size`, which are what a reconciliation compares a provider's answer against -- is outside every UPDATE grant to every role, asserted per column against the live ACL at apply time and against the grant TEXT in the static suite.

CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md's PREFIX RULE IS EXPRESSED AS DATA AND ITS OTHER HALF IS A BLOCKER. `asset_versions_object_key_names_one_object` refuses a stored key containing `%`, `*`, `?` or `..`, or with a leading or TRAILING slash -- a key ending in `/` is a folder, and "delete everything under it" is the recursive prefix delete the rule forbids arriving as data. An apply-time assertion refuses any column in the batch named like a prefix. NONE OF THAT CONSTRAINS A `WHERE` CLAUSE, and §9.3's approved immutable snapshot of exact keys has no table and no owner in §6's registry. Open blocker 2.

NO RETENTION NUMBER IS ENCODED FOR ANY OF THE FOUR CLASSES §5 ASSIGNS THIS FAMILY. §10 gives ASSET-ORIGINAL "Trash 30 วัน", ASSET-DERIVATIVE "may purge immediately", RIGHTS-PROOF "2 ปี default" and UPLOAD-TEMP "24 ชั่วโมง", and §10's own header makes every one an engineering default requiring Product/Security/Legal approval before Paid Beta. `purge_after` and `expires_at` are nullable with no default and no arithmetic; the apply-time block refuses any CHECK mentioning an interval and any default on either column. DATA-DEC-07 is research snapshot retention, batch 070's, and is untouched.

CI IS THE FIRST POSTGRESQL THIS SQL MEETS. This machine has no psql, pg_ctl or docker. The migration's apply-time `do $$` block, the 76 isolation cases and the four CI negative-control entries are all unexercised locally; the static suite is what was run here.
